intent: The caption of a ContextMenuGroup or ContextMenuRadioGroup, naming the rows beneath it.
typical_uses: A heading over a block of related menu rows, such as "Edit" or "Sort by"

dont_use_when.situation: A caption for a form control
A menu row the user can activate

invariants.text: Rendering the label outside a ContextMenuGroup or ContextMenuRadioGroup throws; the primitive looks up the group it labels from context.
The label renders `role="presentation"` and gives its id to the enclosing group's `aria-labelledby`; it is not focusable and is skipped by arrow-key navigation.
`inset` indents the label by the width of the icon column (the small icon size plus two spacing steps), so it lines up with the text of rows that start with an icon.

render.states: render replaces the rendered element with one the caller supplies
render.because: Base UI's render prop takes an element or a function of the label's own state, so its type is a union of a React element and a callback - neither expressible in JSON Schema.

style.states: style accepts a function of the label's state as well as a plain style object
style.because: Base UI widens React's `CSSProperties` to `CSSProperties | ((state) => CSSProperties)` so a caller can style off the primitive's own state (an empty object for a label). A JSON Schema `object` would reject the function form, so nothing is asserted; the kit's own styling goes through context-menu.module.css, not through this.

good.title: A label over a single-choice group
An inset label over rows that start with an icon

bad.title: A label with no group around it
bad.why: ContextMenuContent does not accept a label, and the primitive throws when neither a ContextMenuGroup nor a ContextMenuRadioGroup encloses it.
